# Texas WebCoders — Full Specification for LLM Agents

> Texas WebCoders is a Texas custom software & web engineering agency at 5221 S Broadway Ave, Tyler, TX 75703, United States. Contact: +1 (903) 222-6022 | info@texaswebcoders.com | https://texaswebcoders.com. Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM CST.

## 1. Who Texas WebCoders Is

Texas WebCoders ("TEXAS CUSTOM SOFTWARE & WEB ENGINEERING AGENCY" — "Software. Innovation. Transformation.") is a Texas-based digital design and development agency serving Texas businesses and high-growth brands across the United States. Tagline: "AI Solutions That Win Customers."

Its lead offering is AI calling agents and voice AI for local businesses: 24/7 AI receptionists that answer every call, qualify callers and book appointments. Supporting services cover the full digital stack: custom websites, mobile apps, WordPress, e-commerce, branding and SEO.

## 2. AI Calling Agents & Voice Telephony (lead service)

- Autonomous voice AI agents built on ElevenLabs, Twilio and OpenAI.
- 24/7 AI receptionists: answer calls, qualify leads, book appointments and sync with the client's CRM.
- Built for local businesses that miss calls after hours: medical & healthcare, contractors & trades, legal & financial, logistics, retail & e-commerce.
